decisions.reason: The black-finish range sits close to the firm's core drainage know-how and its own R&D, and it gained a dedicated page in 2024, so management can interpret its results and refine it within the established design concept.

This shower channel for seamless coverings extends the firm's core channel technology, has had a page of its own in both years, and supports the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy, making it easy to assimilate and improve.

The pump-drain shower channel builds on existing channel know-how and appears to carry forward lessons from the withdrawn pump solution C, so in-house R&D gives the firm enough related knowledge to keep developing it despite some risk.
